Decided 2026-10-06 by the sole maintainer (Milo Kang, milocosmopolitan, repository owner) for credential-evidence#243. Question: Does the static auth access token need a positive Case of its own when it shares the Bearer header with the existing HubSpot Bearer Case? Options: Author a family-specific Case; add the family to the existing Case (an edit to a decided record); or author none. Decision: Author a family-specific Case and leave the existing Case untouched. Reason: The static auth token is a distinct role with its own documented configuration and the existing Case lists other families; an edit would reopen a decided record. Finalized by the sole maintainer alone under the solo-maintainer period (ADR 0020): not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). Recorded by an AI agent on the owner's explicit instruction of 2026-10-06 (complete redact-secret#1228, #1229 and #1230 before the next release; Cases for these groups are authored maintainer-only, as in Batch 2).
events.dissent: No dissent was raised. The strongest counter-argument, recorded because the rule asks for one: The expectation is the same sentence as the existing Bearer Case with a family name substituted, and the pages give no marker that distinguishes the token from an OAuth access token.
